{{Short description|Portuguese mathematician (born 1956)}}
[[File:Jorge Nuno Silva.jpg|thumb|160px|Jorge Nuno Silva]]
'''Jorge Nuno Silva''' (born 1956) is a Portuguese mathematician who taught at the [[University of Lisbon]], starting in 1995 and retiring in 2023.<ref>[https://ciencias.ulisboa.pt/en/perfil/jnsilva Jorge Nuno Monteiro De Oliveira E Silva] Faculty: University of Lisbon</ref>  His interests encompass the pedagogy of mathematics, history of mathematics, history of board games, mathematical games, and [[recreational mathematics]]. He is the chief editor for ''Recreational Mathematics Magazine''<ref>[https://sciendo.com/it/journal/rmm Managing Editor: Jorge Nuno Silva] Recreational Mathematics Magazine</ref> and ''Board Game Studies Journal''.<ref>[https://sciendo.com/journal/BGS Managing Editor: Jorge Nuno Silva] Board Game Studies Journal</ref>

==Education==
In 1974, Silva completed his secondary education at the National Lyceum of Viana do Castelo. Subsequently, in 1976/77, he enrolled at the University of Lisbon School of Medicine. In 1983, he earned his Bachelor of Science degree in Pure Mathematics from the University of Lisbon Faculty of Sciences (FCUL).<ref name=CV>[https://www.cienciavitae.pt/421F-25FE-0ECB Curriculum vitae: Jorge Nuno Silva] Cienciacitae.pt</ref> In 1991 he obtained a Master of Arts degree at UC Berkeley, writing ''Some Notes on Game Bounds'' under the direction of [[Elwyn Berlekamp]].<ref>''[https://www.dissertation.com/m/books/1581120214 Some Notes on Game Bounds]'' dissertation.com</ref> In 1994 he got a Ph.D. at the [[University of California, Berkeley]] with the dissertation, "Some Notes on the Theory of Hilbert Spaces of Analytic Functions on the Unit Disc" under doctoral advisor [[Donald Erik Sarason]].<ref name=mgp>[https://mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=32509 Jorge-Nuno Oliveira Silva] at the [[Mathematics Genealogy Project]]</ref>

==Teaching==
From 1995 until his retirement in April 2023 he was a professor at the University of Lisbon.<ref name=CV/> First at the Department of Mathematics (1995-2006), and then at the Department of History and Philosophy of Science (2006-2023).

He is a teacher trainer for [[Associação Ludus]] and the [[Portuguese Mathematical Society]].

==Mathematics promotion==
In 1998 Silva wrote ''Berkley Problems of Mathematics'', a compendium of problems which is widely used by PhD candidates as a reference.<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://link.springer.com/book/9780387204291 |title=Berkeley Problems in Mathematics |date=2004 |publisher=Springer |series=Problem Books in Mathematics}}</ref> He is president of the Ludus Association (Associação Ludus), an organization for popularizing the culture and history of mathematics.<ref>[http://ludicum.org/ Ludus Association]</ref> He is a member of [[:pt:Centro Interuniversit%C3%A1rio de Hist%C3%B3ria das Ci%C3%AAncias e da Tecnologia|Centro Interuniversitário de História das Ciências e da Tecnologia]] (CIUHCT)

Silva has been involved in efforts to popularize mathematics around the world. In a 2009 interview he stated his guiding philosophy:  "Mathematics is, by its very nature, the pure joy of thinking, and the same goes for board games. There is a lack of challenging activities in our Western culture. Games can close this gap; there are many interrelationships between mathematics, history, and culture."<ref>[https://www.nd-aktuell.de/artikel/157083.mathematik-ist-pures-spielen.html Mathematics is pure play] ND, October 10, 2009 (in German)</ref> In an interview with [[Diário de Notícias]] he said, "One day a great game will be invented to teach Mathematics and the world will change."<ref>[https://www.dn.pt/portugal/um-dia-sera-inventado-um-bom-jogo-para-ensinar-matematica-e-o-mundo-vai-mudar-8997842.html "Um dia será inventado um bom jogo para ensinar Matemática e o mundo vai mudar"] by Ana Sousa Dias, Diário de Notícias, 20 December 2017</ref>

Silva is the co-founder of the Circo Matemático which, since its founding in 2011, has toured more than a dozen countries on four continents promoting the popularization of mathematics.<ref>[https://circomatematico.pt/ Circo Matemático]</ref> 

In Portugal he has had an enormous effect on mathematics in public education<ref name=konane/> and he often appears on [[Rádio e Televisão de Portugal]] (RTP) as an expert on games.<ref>[https://www.rtp.pt/programa/tv/p40436/e8 Guided tour of the church of São Roque, host of Social Games of the Portuguese State], RTP, May 3, 2021</ref><ref>[https://arquivos.rtp.pt/conteudos/jogos-matematicos/ Mathematical Games: Debate on Science with Jorge Nuno Silva et al.], RTP, June 30, 2005</ref>
